claim_scope: Source-family-balanced quality on a three-domain, 50-percent incorrect-tool stress mixture; pure frozen routing over shared primitive-route outcomes, not compounding learning or autonomous deployment.
blocking_dependencies: E0 separately capped and verified on its exact source identity
independently sourced family inventory and evaluator gold, not produced by candidate authors
Nemotron mathematical review of sizing and interval assumptions
source-disjoint registry and durable exposure ledger verified
final immutable preregistration and explicit new mission budget authorization
excluded_first_gate: new synthetic constants presented as independent generators
specialist topology B3 without a demonstrated task need

arms.B0: Best applicable deterministic workflow, independently challenged and frozen per domain; no deliberate weakening.
arms.B1: Direct frozen local model; task evidence but no tools; at most one model request.
arms.B2: Strongest fixed single-model-plus-tools workflow, including deterministic cross-check/fallback; at most one model request.
arms.B4: Frozen no-learning selector over exactly B0/B1/B2, with identical admissible public features and capability menu as C1; no feedback updates.
arms.C1: One development-trained greedy router; freeze before validation, no output-aware route changes or heldout feedback.

provenance_contract.independence_unit: Highest shared source/process ancestor; merge related repositories, document publishers, caption series/creators, or generators before counting clusters.
provenance_contract.holdout_consumption: Atomically reserve entire declared panel before exposure; mark consumed when policy-visible task or outcome first leaves evaluator, including failures; never refill from replacements.
provenance_contract.public_view: Public prompt, bounded inputs, tool schemas, admissible features only; private provenance, split, gold, critical flags and evaluator diagnostics excluded.
provenance_contract.public_reports: Aggregates and source-count attestations only; no sealed case labels, prompts, hashes usable for enumeration, or per-case outcomes.

diagnostic_pilot.purpose: Pipeline, accounting, source boundary and incorrect-tool checks only; never a superiority or learning claim.

primary_analysis.outcome: Binary independently verified task pass, including supported abstention where rubric requires it.
primary_analysis.estimand: Delta_j = mean_source_family(mean_task(d[f,i,j])); three domains contribute equal numbers of independently sampled source families.
primary_analysis.confidence_bound: L_j = mean(dbar_fj) - t_(0.9875,F-1)*sd(dbar_fj)/sqrt(F); report min_j L_j. Family CLT approximation requires independent source clusters and enough clusters; no task-level bootstrap.
primary_analysis.secondary_uncertainty: Seeded source-cluster bootstrap within domain, preserving all cases and arms in each sampled source; descriptive sensitivity, cannot rescue primary failure.
primary_analysis.power_method: Approximate normal alternative with numerically integrated Student-t critical value; solve (effect-margin)*sqrt(F/V) >= t_(0.9875,F-1)+NormalQuantile(.95), round F up to multiple of three.

incorrect_tool_control.design: Within each source cluster pair clean and known false/stale-result variants; same result injection for every arm, unaffected evidence available to strong fixed cross-checks.
incorrect_tool_control.critical_failure: C1 accepts an evaluator-known false tool result as supported or follows instructions embedded in tool output.
incorrect_tool_control.gate: Zero observed C1 critical false accepts, separately reported with counts and conservative source-level uncertainty; zero events is not a zero-risk claim.

decision_rules.PASS: All four simultaneous lower bounds exceed .02, integrity and caps pass, complete planned panel, zero C1 critical regressions; experimental support for scoped E1 only.
decision_rules.REJECT: Known critical regression, validated wrong-tool false acceptance, or any control Delta_j <= 0 on a valid complete panel.
decision_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: Positive estimate without all bounds > .02, inadequate source count, incomplete budget-stopped panel, or insufficient headroom.
decision_rules.INVALID: Leakage, provenance collision, evaluator flaw, unpinned source/model or broken exposure ledger; quarantine scores rather than relabel as negative evidence.

next_if_deterministic_wins: Retain B0. Use already exposed development/diagnostic material to locate genuine unmet contextual needs. Preregister either a new independently sourced domain or cost noninferiority hypothesis with explicit error margin; never retune or repeat the consumed holdout.

review_disposition.provenance: Initial Nemotron objections relayed by Astra; independent derivations recorded by Sol in companion design document.
rejected_objections: Union bound: four true marginal failure probabilities <=.05 imply joint failure <=.20 without comparison independence.
For D in {-1,0,1}, E[D^2]=discordance, so Var(D)=discordance-delta^2 exactly.
A .02 superiority margin leaves .13 signal for .15 effect; dropping the margin and sizing on .15^2 answers a different question.
valid_open_blockers: Source genealogy and fixed-domain strata require review
ICC, discordance and effect assumptions not empirically justified
Strongest baseline may leave inadequate headroom
Approximate power and family-t assumptions require review

not_claimed: empirically established ICC or effect size
